# API reference

|---|---|

| [github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/model](model.md) | Package model defines the typed, normalized representation of IEC 61850 namespace definitions (NSD): namespaces, logical node classes, data objects, common data classes (CDCs), data attributes, constructed attributes, enumerations, functional constraints and presence conditions, together with provenance, diagnostics and the module's error taxonomy. |

| [github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/official](official.md) | Package official embeds the IEC 61850 information model of the official IEC NSD packages tracked by this module, so that programs can look up classes, data objects, CDCs and types, resolve references and describe measurements without downloading or loading any IEC file. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/ontology](ontology.md) | Package ontology exposes a namespace profile as a small, typed concept graph: logical node classes contain data objects, data objects use CDCs, CDCs contain attributes, attributes have types, definitions belong to namespaces, and — with semantic mapping enabled — measurements represent quantities, belong to phases and are measured by data objects. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/presence](presence.md) | Package presence evaluates the presence conditions of IEC 61850 information models (IEC 61850-7-3 Table 1 and the PresenceConditions of the 7-2 NSD, as IEC 61850-7-7 declares them) against an instance: the data objects of a logical node, or the attributes and sub data objects of a data object, that a device or an SCL type actually has. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/reference](reference.md) | Package reference parses, validates and formats IEC 61850 object references. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/resolver](resolver.md) | Package resolver resolves references and model paths against a namespace profile, from a logical node class through data objects, sub data objects and CDCs down to data attributes, constructed types and basic or enumerated leaf types: |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850-model/semantic](semantic.md) | Package semantic describes IEC 61850 model elements in engineering terms: quantity (frequency, voltage, active power, ...), phase (A, AB, total, ...), voltage reference (line-neutral, line-ground, line-line), energy direction, the value component an attribute holds (magnitude, angle, counter, quality, ...) and a unit hint. |
